messages:
ajay: Heads-up — scheduling a rolling NIC + BMC firmware maintenance in az13 tonight 00:30–04:30 UTC. We started seeing intermittent egress oscillations after the nicdriver 2.5.1 rollout (sporadic packet drops -> transient 5xx tails). Vendor recommends microcode bump + NIC FW restart. Expected impact: short network flap during node reboot; estimate ~6–10% GPU capacity offline while nodes come back. Plan below.

sasha: what’s the canary plan?

ajay: Canary = 2 GPU nodes in az13-cohort-a. Steps: apply NIC FW, BMC reboot, run egress/ingress smoke (iperf + curl), then model-serving smoke (3x gen @100 tokens). If canary passes for 20m we proceed in cohorts of 10 nodes every 20m.

chris: any risk to KV cache / long-lived contexts? want to avoid mass cold-cache regressions for serving.

ajay: KV cache will be flushed when a node reboots. Mitigations: route live traffic to warm pools (`route-policy: prefer-warm-pool`) and enable prefix-cache warmup on backfills. After each cohort we run the warmup job:

```
./ops/warm_prefix.sh --model gpt-medium --parallel 4
```

Also we’ll pause spot backfills and delay autoscaler to avoid cyclical evictions.

maria: pls add to status page + update runbook. Also open GH issue for cost delta estimate and tag finance.

ajay: will do. Cost note: we’ll burn burst fallback capacity in us-west for ~3h during the busiest phase — rough delta ~+$900. We’ll also temporarily disable spot fills for az13. Commands to annotate autoscaler: `kubectl annotate daemonset autoscaler pause-maint=true`

dev-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: https://tickets/RED-2391 (owner: ajay)

sasha: which customers in az13 we should proactively notify?

ajay: EnterpriseCorp and FinServX are in az13; account reps notified earlier today. Ops outreach email sent.

chris: fallback policy if we see degraded latency/throughput?

ajay: If any route sees p50>250ms or p95>500ms for >5m we will reroute to quantized variants and lower batch sizes. Failover command: `routectl set policy az13 fallback-to quantized-variants`

chris: I’ll keep an eye on evals and quick regressions. Prep rollback for model routes: `routectl set default-model redwood/gpt-medium-v2`

maria: can we run a preflight at 23:45 UTC to validate scripts (drain, warmup, canary checks)?

ajay: Yes — preflight 23:45 UTC. Preflight steps: 
1) dry-run drain with 1 node: `./fleetctl drain --selector az=az13 --nodes 1 --dry-run`
2) apply nic fw to canary test bench
3) smoke checks
If preflight fails we abort the window.

sasha: ack — I’ll be oncall and will coordinate comms during the window.

ajay: TL;DR: 00:30–04:30 UTC rolling NIC+BMC reboots in az13, canary 2 nodes, cohorts of 10, expected 6–10% capacity reduction, prefix cache warmup after cohorts. Runbook: https://runbooks/az13-nic-maint. Ping me for questions. :white_check_mark:
